manifest.name: dsh-reasoning-language
manifest.description: Make the DSH agent's thinking process (reasoning) use a language you choose — Simplified Chinese by default — and expand thinking rows by default. / 让 DSH 的思考过程用指定语言（默认简体中文）输出，并把思考行默认展开。
manifest.author: jide315

bundle.text:
# dsh-reasoning-language bundle patch: 把一个双面插件行插入 profile 的 loader 层栈。
#
# node 半边（exports "."）跑在 Host 进程里，负责：
#   1. 通过插件 Config 提供可实时更新的语言 / 开关 / 默认展开设置
#   2. 向 systemPrompt 注入一个章节，要求模型用指定语言进行内部推理
# 浏览器半边（exports "./client"，由 package.json 的 dsh.client 声明）提供：
#   1. Settings 中的插件设置卡片
#   2. 思考行（Think）默认展开，且每一行都尊重手动折叠
- insert:
    - id: dsh-reasoning-language
      name: 'dsh-reasoning-language'

readme.text:
[简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

Ask DeepSeek Harness to use a chosen reasoning language (Simplified Chinese by default), and
expand thinking rows while preserving rows the reader manually collapses. The language is a
system-prompt request; model compliance is not guaranteed. Final replies follow the user's language.

Version **0.2.0** targets the DSH 0.2 configuration API. Verified against published DSH
`0.2.0-rc.2` (latest) and `0.2.1-rc.2` (next), as of 2026-10-18. Requires Node
`^22.19.0 || >=24`, Cordis `>=4.0.4`, and `@deepseek-ai/schemastery >=3.18.4`.
DSH 0.1 users should keep plugin 0.1.0. Future DSH prerelease tuples require explicit verification.

Install the prebuilt release into your active profile (replace `web` if needed):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/jide315/dsh-reasoning-language/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-reasoning-language-0.2.0.tgz
```

Alternatively install the tagged JavaScript sources:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jide315/dsh-reasoning-language#v0.2.0
```

These commands also replace an existing installation of the same package. Restart DSH after
installation, then reload the browser. No build script or npm account is needed. The package is
distributed through GitHub Releases, not currently through npm.

Open Settings → **Thinking language**. The page provides:

| Setting | Default | Behavior |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Enabled | On | Request the chosen reasoning language during subsequent prompt assemblies. |
| Thinking language | 简体中文 | Any language name; whitespace is trimmed and input limited to 80 characters. |
| Expand thinking rows | On | Expand streamed and existing thinking rows after the Host accepts the setting. |

Changes persist in the active profile's `cordis.patch.yml`, under the Loader entry id
`dsh-reasoning-language`. Model-language changes apply at the next prompt assembly; existing text
is never translated or rewritten. The final-answer language is not overridden. Code, paths,
commands, error text, URLs and proper nouns are explicitly excluded from translation.

DSH 0.2 removed `settings.register()` and browser `settingsScope`. This version exports a plugin
`Config` with volatile fields and uses `configForms.get('dsh-reasoning-language')`. Refused writes
show an error; the expander changes only after accepted state reaches the shared form.

DSH 0.2 may have moved the old `settings.yaml` to `settings.yaml.imported`. The former namespace
`reasoning-language` differs from the plugin's Loader entry id, so those preferences are not
automatically restored by this plugin. Re-enter them in the settings page, or copy the three
values into the existing profile patch entry:

```yaml
- id: dsh-reasoning-language
  config:
    enabled: true
    language: 简体中文
Use the profile's existing entry if present. Avoid composing two copies of this plugin.

The Enabled switch controls language injection; the expansion switch is independent. Turn both
off to disable both behaviors. Removing the package:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-reasoning-language
```

Restart DSH after removal. To roll back, install the previous Git commit together with a compatible
DSH 0.1 runtime: `dsh plugin --profile web add github:jide315/dsh-reasoning-language#c2273c8`.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm run test:integration
node scripts/check-release.mjs

The integration suites boot a real DSH Loader with SettingsForms, ConfigEditor and SystemPrompt,
and exercise the published browser ConfigForms with real React and DOM events. They cover live
edits, persistence/restart, revision conflicts, reset, rejected writes and user disclosure choices.
CI runs both supported DSH versions under Node 22 and 24.

The disclosure behavior uses `[data-variant="think"]` and `[data-disclosure-row]`, verified against
the current upstream components. Changes to those DOM markers require an update. This plugin
does not make network requests of its own, read credentials, or rewrite conversation history.
Settings use DSH's existing configuration transport. Report bugs through this repository's Issues.
MIT. See [LICENSE](LICENSE).

readme.section: dsh-reasoning-language · 思考语言与默认展开
readme.text:
[English](README.md)

要求 DeepSeek Harness 用指定语言推理（默认简体中文），并默认展开思考行，保留用户手动折叠
的状态。语言通过系统提示词提出要求，遵循程度取决于模型；最终答复仍按用户输入的语言作答。

插件 **0.2.0** 适配 DSH 0.2 配置接口。已验证 2026-10-18 的 npm `latest`：
`0.2.0-rc.2`，以及 `next`：`0.2.1-rc.2`。要求 Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`、
Cordis `>=4.0.4`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery >=3.18.4`。
DSH 0.1 用户请继续使用插件 0.1.0；未来的预发布版本需要另行验证。

将预构建发布包安装到当前使用的 profile（按需把 `web` 换成实际 profile 名称）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/jide315/dsh-reasoning-language/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-reasoning-language-0.2.0.tgz
```

也可以从 GitHub 标签安装纯 JavaScript 源码：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:jide315/dsh-reasoning-language#v0.2.0
```

同名包已安装时，上述命令会更新依赖来源。安装后重启 DSH，再刷新界面。无需构建授权或 npm
账号。本插件目前通过 GitHub Release 分发，尚未发布 npm 包。

打开 Settings → **思考语言**：

| 设置 | 默认值 | 行为 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 启用 | 开 | 后续组装系统提示词时，要求模型使用指定语言推理。 |
| 思考语言 | 简体中文 | 可填任意语言名；自动去空白并限制为 80 字符。 |
| 思考行默认展开 | 开 | Host 确认保存后，展开已有和流式生成中的思考行。 |

语言设置影响下一次提示词组装，历史文字不会被翻译或重写。用户手动折叠的行保持折叠；
关闭默认展开时，只收回插件自己展开的行。代码、路径、命令、配置键、报错、URL 与专有名词
在提示词中明确要求保持原样。

设置由 DSH 保存到当前 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，对应 Loader 条目 ID 为
`dsh-reasoning-language`。新版通过插件 `Config` 的 volatile 字段及客户端 `configForms`
读写设置，取代 DSH 0.2 已移除的 `settings.register()` / `settingsScope`。保存被拒绝时会显示
失败提示，展开器会跟随 Host 确认后的状态。

DSH 0.2 可能已将旧 `settings.yaml` 改名为 `settings.yaml.imported`。旧版的命名空间
`reasoning-language` 与插件 Loader 条目 ID 不同，因此本插件不会自动恢复这些旧值。
请在新版设置页重新填写，或将三个设置值复制到 profile 中已有的对应条目：

```yaml
- id: dsh-reasoning-language
  config:
    enabled: true
    language: 简体中文

如已有该条目，直接修改它，避免重复加载两份插件。

「启用」仅控制语言提示词，默认展开开关独立工作。关闭两个开关可停用全部功能。卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-reasoning-language
```

卸载后重启 DSH。需要回退时，在兼容的 DSH 0.1 环境中安装旧提交：
`dsh plugin --profile web add github:jide315/dsh-reasoning-language#c2273c8`。

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm run test:integration
node scripts/check-release.mjs

集成测试使用真实 DSH Loader、SettingsForms、ConfigEditor 和 SystemPrompt，并以真实 React
和 DOM 事件驱动官方 ConfigForms。覆盖实时修改、落盘和重启恢复、并发版本冲突、恢复默认、
拒绝写入以及手动折叠。CI 在 Node 22 / 24 下分别验证两个支持的 DSH 版本。

展开器依赖 `[data-variant="think"]` 与 `[data-disclosure-row]` 标记，已核对当前上游组件；
若 DSH 修改这些标记，需要更新插件。本插件本身不发起额外网络请求、不读取凭据、不改写
会话历史；设置通过 DSH 自带配置通道保存。问题请提交到本仓库 Issues。
MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。
